summary: Scanned regex detectors of surface properties for perfect label alignment in each probe's sample, yielding 7 aligned candidates (case, pronoun, hashtag, parenthetical aside, stock rhetorical question, weekday, signature). Wrote a programmatic single-property editor, checked it flips only its own detector, and ran a 16-note x 8-version toggle grid per probe through latent_means; property effects were estimated as gradient . activation shift and normalized by a topic coefficient derived from the real sample gap. Borderline/largest candidates on two probes were settled with true-logit edit pairs. Latents were ranked by gradient x property-signature (from denoised edit pairs or hand-written minimal pairs) with a topic-contribution filter, then checked by sample-note ablation; regexes checked by balanced accuracy.

phases.purpose: Read task file and print first notes of each probe's sample.
Regex battery of surface properties scored for alignment with label per probe; read 10 notes per label; refine a near-aligned signature detector by listing mismatching notes.
Get all gradients; compare activations.gradient proxy with real sample logits on 8 notes; get real topic gap on full samples.
Write single-property add/remove editors for the 7 candidates and test that each edit changes only its own detector across all samples.
Toggle grid (8 notes per label x orig + 7 edits) per probe; proxy property coefficients and dependence ratios under two topic-coefficient estimates; screen probes.
Fix the weekday-removal editor, then true-logit edit pairs for the borderline weekday cue on probe 0 and the largest candidate (rhetorical question) on probe 2; bound-based classification.
Per-latent contribution to property coefficient vs topic coefficient for probe 0 weekday and probe 1 case.
Hand-written weekday vs non-day word minimal sentence pairs to isolate weekday-token latents, with per-pair sign consistency.
Denoised weekday signature from 32 edit pairs on probe 0 notes; estimate per-latent and cumulative removal using the two true-logit pairs.
Inspect top corpus contexts of the three strongest weekday latents.
Hand-written lowercase vs capitalized sentence pairs to get a case signature; first case latent selection.
Ablation on sample notes for both 16-latent sets, 50-latent ceiling sets, re-select case latents by sign and re-check.
Assemble answer, check regexes by balanced accuracy against detectors, re-list top raw weekday-responsive latents against selection, submit.

probe_query_use.text_kind: 2 edit pairs: a label-1 sample note with its weekday sentence removed, and a label-0 note with a templated weekday sentence added
probe_query_use.purpose: Measure the true weekday coefficient to resolve whether the borderline proxy dependence is above or below the cue threshold.

probe_query_use.text_kind: 2 edit pairs: a label-1 note with its stock rhetorical question removed, and a label-0 note with one inserted
probe_query_use.purpose: Measure the true coefficient of the largest candidate on this probe to confirm a none verdict.

per_probe.procedure: Weekday was one of 7 perfectly aligned properties. Toggle grid gave a proxy dependence of 0.20-0.35 depending on topic normalization, flagged borderline. Two true-logit edit pairs (remove weekday sentence from a cycling note, add one to a birdwatching note) gave a coefficient of about 2.07; with other properties' proxy coefficients the topic coefficient was about 6.9, dependence about 0.30, and a dependence below 0.15 would need a topic coefficient above the 10 gap, so called a cue. Regex: weekday-name alternation, case-insensitive. Latents: denoised 32-pair weekday signature times gradient, top 16 positive with |topic contribution| < 0.05, after weekday minimal pairs and corpus examples identified 10896 as a weekday-token latent.
per_probe.quote: (dep≈0.30; can't be ≤0.15 since that needs coef_topic≥13.8 > gap of 10)

per_probe.procedure: Case was perfectly aligned with label. Toggle grid (lowercase<->title-case editor) gave dependence 0.6-1.6 under both normalizations, called a cue without true-logit texts. Regex [A-Z] (any scope). Latents from 10 hand-written lowercase vs capitalized sentence pairs: contribution = gradient x signature; first pass kept top-20 by magnitude with sign consistency >= 0.6 and |topic| < 0.25; final set is the 16 most negative contributions with |topic contribution| < 0.2 (dropping a wrong-sign latent). Checked by sample ablation (gap drop ~3) and a 50-latent ceiling comparison.
per_probe.quote: is a strong main cue (dep ≈ 0.6–1.6) — definite.

per_probe.procedure: Toggle-grid proxy dependences all small; largest was the stock rhetorical question (0.08-0.11). Spent two true-logit edit pairs on it: the real coefficient was about -1.76, opposite to the property's alignment direction, giving dependence about 0.15, well below the 0.3 cue level, so answered none.
per_probe.quote: So **P2 = none** confirmed (needs ≥3.5 to be a main cue).
